tools.name: vectorize
tools.description: Convert a raster image (PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF, up to 10 MB) into a vector file. Returns a rendered PNG preview of the result and the complete file source as text, ready to save as .svg, .dxf or .eps, with a download link to that file valid 24 hours. Input: image_url, a public http(s) link to the ima
